# Workspace Instructions

- Keep the user-facing site in `index.html`; use the existing Vite and Supabase setup for shared media storage.
- Keep names, giveaway information, and meet details factual; replace placeholders only with confirmed clan information.
- Gallery and montage tiles are visual placeholders until real clan media is supplied.
- Validate changes with `npm run build` and the Vite development server. Supabase bucket policies are in `supabase/storage-setup.sql`.

## Setup Checklist

- [x] Verify the workspace instructions file exists.
- [x] Clarify project requirements.
- [x] Scaffold the project.
- [x] Customize the project for the clan.
- [x] Install required extensions. None are needed for this static site.
- [x] Build the project with Vite and verify it in a browser.
- [x] Create and run a task. Skipped because opening the HTML file is sufficient.
- [x] Launch the project through the Vite development server.
- [x] Ensure the README and workspace instructions are current.
